text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the morning after the Pretty Grand
Prix
preliminaries. Just as I'm
trying to work
through a pile of paperwork...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, terrible news! Curren Chan is
nowhere to be found...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan has... disappeared?! The
rumor spreads through the
academy like
wildfire.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, she left me a letter in her
room. I take the letter from
Tazuna and
gently open it.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: "I'm going on a journey to seek enlightenment. There's gotta be a wise old Uma-sage out there somewhere."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Big Bro,
sorry for deciding this all on my
own. It's something I have to
do, for my
dream..."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Big Sis,
sorry for deciding this all on my
own. It's something I have to
do, for my
dream..."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The letter abruptly ends there...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I feel like the sage thing must be a
reference I'm not catching, but
maybe
there's better clues on her Umastagram.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sure enough,
the top post is a selfie of her
smiling sadly at a port to an island,
uploaded a few seconds ago. The caption
reads...

text_block_list.name: @Curren
text_block_list.text:
"#AWindblownFlower
#SweptMindlesslyByTheTide

#CrestsTheWaterfall"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The hashtags make a haiku... I wouldn't
have pegged Curren Chan as the poetry
type, but I guess the flower imagery is a
metaphor for her
current state of mind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: More importantly—I have to go after her! Just in case, I'll bring that with me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I arrive at the island,
but I can't see any
signs that people actually live
here. Did
Curren Chan really come this far out?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I explore deeper into the mountains, I
hear the sound of a large
waterfall nearby.
And alongside the roar of rushing water...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
This is... very... painful... but for my
training... I must... endure...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan is muttering a sutra-like
incantation underneath a roaring 
waterfall?!
I hastily run to her rescue and
bring her out of the mountains!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you found me... I can always count
on you to find me when I'm
lost, Big Bro.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you found me... I can always count
on you to find me when I'm
lost, Big Sis.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I know that she left that hint on her
Umasta specifically so I could
follow her
steps and find her.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Mhm... Sure thing. What do you want to
talk about?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Up until now, she hasn't talked about
herself with me at all. Hearing
my reply,
Curren Chan gently smiles.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
So, Big Bro... you want to know more than
just the "cute" me?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
So, Big Sis... you want to know more than
just the "cute" me?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, tell me this. Are you prepared... to
know everything about me?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I nearly flinch at the intensity of her
gaze,
but... if I can't look her eye
to eye now,
then I don't deserve to be her trainer.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... You asked for it. Well then, why
don't I start from when I was
born?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You know how babies instinctively laugh a
lot? Well, when I was a
baby, I was always
laughing too.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
And when I laughed, my family would
laugh along with me. They
called me cute,
and it seemed to bring them so much
happiness.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Your cuteness has the power to make
everyone happy." That's what
my Big
Bro—my actual brother, I mean—said to
me.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Back then, I made up my mind to always
be as cute as I can. That
was... when I was
about three, I think?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
And to do that, I spent a lot of time
researching how to be cute. One
day, one
of my followers came up to me and said...

text_block_list.name: Curren Follower
text_block_list.text:
E-excuse me! You're the Umastagrammer,
Curren, right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Follower
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I was able to muster up the
courage to change myself.
Curren, you're
my hero.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...Her words made me so happy. They
made me realize that my cuteness could
bring joy to not only my own family,
but so many
others too.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I was happy when people called me cute,
and everyone was happy
when I was cute.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to spread this circle of
happiness
as far as I could!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I never imagined that her concept of
"cuteness" had so much deeper
meaning
behind it.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Well... Whenever I saw Umamusume racing
on TV, they always shined
so brilliantly.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
They were dripping sweat, their hair was
windswept, and a lot of the time, they
weren't even smiling. Some of them even
looked kinda
scary...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
They couldn't have been further from the
cuteness I'd known, refined,
and believed
in. But when I watched them run...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Cute" was the first word that came to
mind. Like, they were
practically sparkling!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I thought that if I enrolled at Tracen Academy and won races too, then I could sparkle like them... No, scratch that! I could sparkle even brighter than them!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to spread my name around to
even more people! And one
day, the
whole world would fall in love with me!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...But at the Grand Prix preliminaries
race,
I couldn't live up to
everyone's
expectations.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You see, cuteness has to be absolutely
perfect. If I destroy people's
dreams...
That's not cute at all.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Having my cleat fall off because I didn't prep properly? That's the most uncute thing ever!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: That's why I came here to train! I won't let myself make the same mistake again—I will change!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I think I finally understand. Curren is a
perfectionist who'll never stop
trying to
improve herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her cuteness isn't just a whim or fancy.
She works every second of
every day to make
sure it radiates from every fiber of her
body.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Take her racing,
for instance. Her sprinting
isn't something easily emulated—she
must've put in countless hours of training
to even get to this point.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And she did it all... to be cute.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Are you calling me cute? It doesn't
feel like it, though.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I hate losing, huh? Maybe... you're right.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For the first time,
I feel like I understand Curren Chan as an
Umamusume. And I've
got to say, I respect her way of life and
how she dedicates herself to it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Which means... I have a job to do as her
trainer. It's up to me to make
her dreams
come true!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We'll keep on training, until she can feel
confident in her cuteness on the track
again. And to that end, I take out her
fallen cleat and hold
it out to her.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe. Thanks, Big Bro.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe. Thanks, Big Sis.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Finally, Curren and I have become true
trainer and trainee. And somehow, I'm sure
that the legendary Uma-sage is watching
over us
right now with a smile.
